title: Find the average overall rating of players who share the highest potential
question: Find the average overall rating of players who share the highest potential score, weigh less than 160 pounds, prefer their left foot when attacking, and whose performance data was recorded between 2007 and 2016.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(pa."XCL_132") AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player AS p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
WHERE pa."XCL_133" = (SELECT MAX("XCL_133") FROM Player_Attributes)
  AND p."XCL_127" < 160
  AND pa."XCL_134" = 'left'
  AND pa."XCL_135" = 'attacking'
  AND pa."XCL_131" BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2016-12-31'
